mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, title, content, type, message_type, is_read, sender_id, related_id, source, link_url, biz_type, biz_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, COALESCE(#{messageType}, 1), COALESCE(#{isRead}, 0), #{senderId}, #{relatedId}, #{source}, #{linkUrl}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{createTime})

INSERT INTO notification (user_id, title, content, type, message_type, is_read, sender_id, related_id, source, create_time) VALUES
(#{m.userId}, #{m.title}, #{m.content}, COALESCE(#{m.type}, 0), COALESCE(#{m.messageType}, 1), COALESCE(#{m.isRead}, 0), #{m.senderId}, #{m.relatedId}, #{m.source}, COALESCE(#{m.createTime}, NOW()))
